summary: And at some point they found out when a kid like this gets into a shit,  the best thing that you can possibly do is stay as close as possible to this kid, which is difficult because what you really want to do is go away.
And he ended up in South Tel Aviv and did not have the good luck to be picked up by Quarental  and roam the streets and became a prominent gang member.
So, for such a kid, when an adult can learn to respect, stays close to him, doesn't walk away from him,  in any situation, irrespective of how he behaves, it's a tremendous healing experience.

Love to the country, to the uphill, to the downhill, to all the incredible creatures that surround us,  the animals, the plants, insects, love and respect to other shallow members in your team,  in your liking team, and most importantly, love and respect to yourself,  which is something that they badly miss.

Now I tell kids, when they struggle through some uphill and feel like they cannot take it anymore,  it truly helps to ignore the immediate obstacle and raise your head and look around and see how the vista around you grows,  which literally propels you upwards.
